name: MAGE J0609-3225 (Hubble)
blurb: MAGE J0609-3225, a satellite galaxy of ESO364-G29, seen by Hubble.
label: mage06093225-hubble
story: This galaxy travels with ESO364-G29, a galaxy only about as massive as the Small Magellanic Cloud. It was found in a hunt for the companions of such small hosts, a reminder that even little galaxies can keep satellites of their own.

claims.text: MAGE J0609-3225 is a velocity-confirmed satellite galaxy of ESO364-G29
It was found by a survey for satellites of LMC- and SMC-mass hosts (ID-MAGE)
MAGE0609-3225 is a target of Hubble program 18070
